text: Walnut Avenue intersects the north side of Richmond Street West in a stop controlled intersection. Based on the Transportation Services review, the installation of the all-way stop control is technically warranted at this intersection. There are planned developments near this intersection and residents are concerned about the safety for road users. The installation of all-way stop control at this intersection will improve safety for all road users at this intersection.
Item TE34.216 was withdrawn from the agenda.
